content:
## Why it's late

WO-2026-00185 (Door Inner Panel (pressed), qty 1, INR book) — **confirmed late**: planned end 2026-10-16, today 2026-10-19, **3 days past due** (is_late=true). It's still in `draft` status and nothing has been produced.

The one signal diagnose_work_order records is **`not_released`** — the order hasn't been released to the floor. That's the only hold-up the data shows; there are no material, subcontract, quality or workstation blockers, and no route/operation rows recorded at all, so there's no job card to point at where it's stuck.

## What it blocks

The reverse BOM walk finds **no confirmed blocks — only potential consumers**, since WorkOrder has no parent/child link. These are **may be affected**, not blocked, because stock or another order could cover the demand:

- Direct material matches: WO-2026-00187, 00186, 00184, 00182, 00180, 00178, 00176, 00174, 00172, 00170, 00168, 00166, 00164, 00162, 00160, 00158, 00156, 00154, 00152, 00150, 00148, 00146, 00144, 00142, 00140, 00138, 00136, 00134, 00132, 00130, 00128, 00126, 00124
- Two levels down (Door Module Sub-assembly / Heat Sink / Motor Controller): WO-2026-00110, 00095, 00080, 00065, 00112, 00107, 00097, 00092, 00082, 00077

**Customer impact is partly unknown** — WO-2026-00185 is make-to-order with no linked sales order, and 33 other work orders in the same position can't be traced to a customer. What is visible (all via potential consumers, so **potential exposure**, not recorded exposure):
- Tata Ficosa Automotive Systems: SO-2026-00027 (due 2026-09-07, ₹2,091,356.95), SO-2026-00192 (due 2026-07-14, ₹1,483,182.12), SO-2026-00187 (due 2026-05-30, ₹1,208,697.60), SO-2026-00056 (due 2026-10-06, ₹914,603.56, already delivered)
- Kirloskar Pumps Ltd: SO-2026-00053 (due 2026-10-10, ₹337,155.46, delivered), SO-2026-00198 (due 2026-08-03, ₹216,054.70), SO-2026-00164 (due 2026-06-30, ₹1,047,415.32), SO-2026-00039 (due 2026-09-19, ₹449,475.88)

## Rescheduling

**I could not apply any change.** propose_reschedule did produce writable proposals — WO-2026-00185 itself (new 2026-10-19 → 2026-10-26) plus ~38 dependants, all with writable_by_seat=true — but when I applied the main order, `apply_reschedule` returned **changed_underneath**: someone else edited WO-2026-00185 at 2026-10-19T22:49:30 while this run was in progress. Per policy I did not retry, and every further write in this run is refused.

I escalated: **ESC-2026-00099** raised, assigned to Meera Kulkarni, due 2026-10-20. A person needs to re-check the order's current state and apply the reschedule (or a revised one) — the agent is locked out for the rest of this run.

Dependants that were **not** writable and would need an admin cancel regardless (status `not_started`, dates locked after submit): WO-2026-00095, 00080, 00065, 00097, 00092, 00082, 00077.

## Not visible to me

Nothing — no entity in this request was outside this seat's reach.
